title: Use Overall System AGV Status screen to identify AGVs with errors (top vs bottom sections)
summary: Use the OptiSweep HMI screen labeled "Overall System AGV Status" to review fleet-level AGV information. The top section shows detailed fields for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors), while the bottom section is filtered to show only AGVs with errors so you can quickly identify which AGVs are currently reporting error details.
when_to_use: When you need to identify which AGVs are currently reporting errors using the "Overall System AGV Status" HMI view, and you want to cross-check the same AGV IDs between the top (all AGVs) and bottom (only AGVs with errors) sections.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Navigate to the "Overall System AGV Status" screen and extract the AGV IDs and their error-related information from the bottom ("Only AGVs with errors") section, then cross-check those IDs in the top section fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors).
access_or_tools_needed: HMI access to the "Overall System AGV Status" screen

access_required: HMI access to the "Overall System AGV Status" screen
system_preconditions: The "Overall System AGV Status" screen must be loaded and showing both the top section (all AGVs) and the bottom section ("Only AGVs with errors").

visual_references.description: Frame showing the "Overall System AGV Status" screen layout with top section (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and bottom section ("Only AGVs with errors").

steps.title: Open the "Overall System AGV Status" HMI screen
steps.purpose: Get to the fleet-level AGV status view that contains both the all-AGVs top section and the errors-only bottom section.
steps.instruction: Navigate to the HMI screen labeled "Overall System AGV Status".
steps.expected_result: The screen titled "Overall System AGV Status" is visible and shows both a top section and a bottom section.
steps.healthy_condition: The top section is present and the bottom section is present and labeled as showing only AGVs with errors.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not load correctly or the expected layout (top section and bottom section) is not visible.

actions.label: Open screen
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the HMI screen labeled "Overall System AGV Status"

stop_or_escalate_if: If the screen does not show the expected "Overall System AGV Status" layout (top and bottom sections), stop and escalate to support for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text shows "Overall System AGV Status" with a top section for detailed info for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and a bottom section for "Only AGVs with errors".

steps.title: Review top section fields for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors)
steps.purpose: Capture the baseline per-AGV details needed to cross-check error AGV IDs found in the errors-only bottom section.
steps.instruction: In the top section, review the detailed fields for all AGVs: "ID", "Status", "Destination", and "Errors".
steps.expected_result: The top section displays columns/fields labeled "ID", "Status", "Destination", and "Errors" for all AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: For any AGV row you select/scan, the row includes values under the "ID", "Status", "Destination", and "Errors" fields.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not show the expected fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) in the top section.

actions.label: Check top section fields
actions.exact_action: Review the top section fields labeled "ID", "Status", "Destination", and "Errors"

stop_or_escalate_if: If the screen does not show the expected fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors), stop and escalate because the screen may not be loaded correctly or may be on a different view.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text shows top section: "Detailed info for all AGVs - ID, Status, Destination, and Errors".

steps.title: Confirm bottom section is filtered to "Only AGVs with errors"
steps.purpose: Ensure the errors-only filter is active so the bottom list represents only AGVs currently reporting errors.
steps.instruction: In the bottom section, confirm the view is filtered to "Only AGVs with errors".
steps.expected_result: The bottom section explicitly indicates it is showing "Only AGVs with errors".
steps.healthy_condition: The bottom section contains only AGV entries that correspond to error reporting (as indicated by the screen’s errors-focused bottom section).
steps.failure_condition: The bottom section does not appear to be filtered to "Only AGVs with errors" or it shows no error entries despite known issues.

actions.label: Verify errors-only filter
actions.exact_action: Confirm the bottom section is labeled/filtered as "Only AGVs with errors"

stop_or_escalate_if: If the bottom section does not appear to be filtered to "Only AGVs with errors" or no AGVs appear there despite known issues, stop and escalate to support for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text shows bottom section: "Only AGVs with errors".

steps.title: Identify error AGV IDs from the bottom section and capture their error-related information
steps.purpose: Extract the specific AGV IDs that are currently in an error state and note the error-related details shown on the screen.
steps.instruction: From the bottom section list, identify which AGV IDs are present as error entries and note their associated error-related information shown on the screen (via the screen’s "Errors" field).
steps.expected_result: You have a list of AGV IDs shown in the bottom section along with the error-related information displayed for those entries.
steps.healthy_condition: Each AGV entry in the bottom section corresponds to an error state and includes error-related details in the errors-focused field(s).
steps.failure_condition: No AGV IDs appear in the bottom section when errors are expected, or the error-related information is not displayed as part of the bottom list.

actions.label: Capture error AGV IDs
actions.exact_action: Identify AGV IDs present in the bottom section and note the associated error-related information shown on the screen

stop_or_escalate_if: If no AGVs appear in the bottom section despite known issues, stop and escalate to support for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The screen layout indicates bottom section is "Only AGVs with errors" and the top section includes an "Errors" field for AGVs.

steps.title: Cross-check the same AGV IDs in the top section (ID/Status/Destination/Errors)
steps.purpose: Confirm that the AGVs identified in the errors-only bottom section match the corresponding entries in the all-AGVs top section, including their status/destination/error fields.
steps.instruction: Use the top section details ("ID", "Status", "Destination", "Errors") to cross-check the same AGV IDs you found in the bottom error-filtered section.
steps.expected_result: For each AGV ID captured from the bottom section, there is a corresponding row in the top section showing the same "ID" and its "Status", "Destination", and "Errors" values.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV IDs match between bottom and top sections, and the top section’s "Errors" field aligns with the bottom section’s error entries.
steps.failure_condition: AGV IDs from the bottom section cannot be found in the top section, or the top section does not show the expected error-related information for those IDs.

actions.label: Cross-check IDs
actions.exact_action: Cross-check the same AGV IDs between the bottom (errors-only) section and the top section fields (ID/Status/Destination/Errors)

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text describes top section fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and bottom section filtered to "Only AGVs with errors".

success_criteria: Bottom section shows "Only AGVs with errors" and contains one or more AGV entries.
You can list the AGV IDs present in the bottom section and capture their error-related information.
Each bottom-section error AGV ID can be found in the top section and the top section shows values for "ID", "Status", "Destination", and "Errors" for those same IDs.
healthy_conditions: Top section displays fields labeled "ID", "Status", "Destination", and "Errors" for all AGVs.
Bottom section is explicitly filtered to "Only AGVs with errors".
Bottom-section error entries correspond to matching AGV IDs in the top section.
failure_conditions: Bottom section is not filtered to "Only AGVs with errors".
Bottom section shows no AGV error entries despite known issues.
Top section does not show the expected fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors).
AGV IDs found in the bottom section cannot be cross-checked in the top section.
escalation_guidance: If the bottom section does not appear to be filtered to "Only AGVs with errors" or no AGVs appear there despite known issues, stop and escalate to support for further investigation.
If the screen does not show the expected fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors), stop and escalate because the screen may not be loaded correctly or may be on a different view.
